verdict.rationale: Warp's own AI produces insights and suggestions from the user's in-product data. 'Ask Warp AI' explains errors in command output and identifies missing dependencies. Generate offers contextual suggestions inside interactive CLI tools such as psql and mysql. MCP can pull context from databases and services. A community user confirms having it examine old files and suggest whether they can be deleted. missing for 10: a dedicated, non-legacy feature for analyzing or summarizing user data into insights (Generate is marked Legacy), and documentation of proactive suggestion features (Prompt Suggestions/Next Command appear only in community reports).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Warp AI can demystify opaque error messages and identify missing dependencies.
contextual suggestions inside interactive commands and programs, whether you're using psql, gdb, git, mysql, or any other CLI tool.
Pull context from databases, APIs, docs, and internal services so the AI understands your full stack.
The agent runs shell commands, reads live output, and drives interactive programs like REPLs, database shells, and full-screen apps.
they have it find old unused files, examine them and suggest whether they can be deleted.
